title: Classroom OS identity control protocol v1 — S2 review candidate
description: Contract bundle 0.2.0 candidate. Local broker/D0 and isolated receiver messages, not public OpenAPI administrator routes. JSON validation does not establish authentication, current authority, signatures, time, ACL or transactional facts.

Secret.description: Secret transport value; never CLI stdout, URL, environment, log, Receipt or Outbox.

Password.description: Existing student target password verification, not a new-password policy field.

KeyPossessionProof.description: Signature covers KeyPopSignedBody under classroom.identity.key-pop.v1, reconstructed with the validated outer approval deployment; not the proof object including signature.

ControlAuthenticateRequest.description: Authority evidence signature covers AuthenticateSignedBody under classroom.identity.authenticate.v1, using the full live hello and kernel-derived OsSubject; actor evidence uses the independent current session verifier.

AuthenticateSignedBody.description: Exact JCS body for classroom.identity.authenticate.v1. Broker reconstructs hello from its live connection challenge and peer from the kernel; a caller-supplied peer never authorizes. The signer uses its own canonical OS subject and the full received hello.

KeyPopSignedBody.description: Exact JCS body for classroom.identity.key-pop.v1. deployment_id comes from the validated outer D0ChangeRequest.approval.body.deployment_id; the other four fields come unchanged from this KeyPossessionProof and must match the authorized change/new manifest. signature is excluded. PoP alone never authorizes registration.

x-invariants: Every request is checked against server-authenticated OS peer and live broker connection context. Client UUIDs, executor echoes, auth_context_id, signatures or schema-valid objects alone confer no authority.

Ed25519 signatures use the pinned purpose-specific D0/maintenance/recovery keys and domain-prefixed RFC8785 canonical UTF-8 JSON. Receiver signatures use P-256 ECDSA SHA-256 P1363 r||s; keys must decode to a valid on-curve point.

Initial D0 trust comes from independently verified existing resource/deployment authorization and external installation approval, never from this input document, self-signature, writable PG or new-key proof of possession.

Every mutation checks the current external D0 high-water and protected manifest against the shared PG deployment guard; maintenance and restart follow the single-broker admission-gate protocol. Missing, rolled-back or mismatched evidence closes the path.

issue/reissue/complete are separate operation-bound proofs; verified_at is the actual server successful verification time before challenge_expiry. All PG locks acquired: now<operation_deadline<=verified_at+120s and all earlier qualification/pending limits. A previously consumed challenge expiry is not the execution deadline.

issue/reissue consume their approval nonce once; complete consumes its different completion nonce and current capability once, switches factors, invalidates old recovery-code group, increases the single security_epoch and commits the op fact/audit/independent identity event atomically.

status uses an ephemeral reusable read-only proof and current original stable executor. It performs no recovery proof/case/op/nonce/cap/factor/epoch write, returns no secret and authorizes no retry. Unknown/missing/unavailable facts remain unknown.

Receiver requests require matching capability, exact case/flow/key, valid single-use server nonce and P1363 proof; receiver has no manual final or control-plane status action. New receiver/reissue requires a new operator approval and flow.

Response cross-field relations, time limits, target role, current ACL, single use, persisted facts and transaction/lock semantics are normative document requirements not proved by JSON Schema validation.
Retention values 90/30 days remain U02 candidates; no real identity/key installation, enrollment or recovery is authorized by this contract candidate.

JSON Schema if/then also rejects complete without factor/confirmation, issue with them, executor/target-role shape mismatch, wrong single_use flag and status response result/stage/audit mismatches; actual executor authority and time/transaction facts remain server obligations.
